partner_chat.details: GET /api/partner-chat/messages returns messages array. POST /api/partner-chat/send creates message with text, media_data, media_type. Messages display in UI with sender name and timestamp.

streak_tracker.details: GET /api/streak returns current_streak, longest_streak, total_days. Streak tracker visible on home screen when streak > 0 or total_days > 0.

shared_playlist.details: Full CRUD: GET returns songs array, POST adds song with title/artist/url/notes, DELETE removes song. UI has add form with all fields.

avatar.details: GET /api/avatar returns avatar data. POST /api/avatar/generate creates AI avatar (not tested due to 30-60s generation time). UI has description input, 6 style options, generate button.

milestones.details: Full CRUD: GET returns milestones array, POST creates milestone with title/date/description/category, DELETE removes milestone. UI has timeline view with 5 category options.

weekly_report.details: GET /api/weekly-report returns AI-generated report text and stats (questions_answered, messages_sent, week_start, week_end). Takes ~5-10 seconds for AI generation.

portrait_sharing.details: Download button present on portrait viewer. Uses browser download API to save portrait as PNG.
